notes.title: Sequential Unlock Logic & Spoiler-Safe Tooltips
changes: Capsules now unlock sequentially so each month opens only after the previous one is unlocked.
Progress marker tooltips hide details for months that are still locked to avoid spoilers.
Direct access to locked capsules is blocked until prerequisite months are opened.

notes.title: Timeline-inspired patch notes
changes: Introduced a dedicated patch notes timeline with a polished modal layout.
Added a header shortcut to quickly open the latest release highlights.
Smoothed animations and readability for update details.
